title: Loud Fart
blurb: Same joke as the standard fart, but with genuine conviction behind it. Nothing here is sneaking past anybody. This is a full-volume, room-stopping declaration that terminates whatever was being discussed. Escalation is a respectable comedic strategy and volume is the cheapest form of escalation available, so every soundboard eventually grows a louder tier. Deploy it when subtlety has already failed, when the moment demands commitment, or when you would like a voice call to conclude immediately and permanently. Pairs beautifully with a slow dramatic zoom, or with a Vine Boom layered underneath for something approaching cinema.
origin: The fart, but louder. Escalation is a valid comedic strategy.
